description: Object /devices (API.md §15; step 5n part B2): the workspace's devices (spec §11). The server keeps a registry of the devices its modules found; a client never lists or probes devices itself. A profile's device is chosen with Profiles/1.set_device and clear_device. Runner devices (spec §18) are not here.

list.description: The registry as it is, by serial: never loads the workspace (an unloaded one has none) and never probes a device.

scan.description: A task (meta.kind scan) that asks each module that has devices to list them, in the caller's environment, and updates the registry (devices no longer listed stay, offline); changed follows when the registry's records differ. A cancel ends it at once and the registry is not updated; a scan whose modules have not all answered within a minute fails.

devices.description: The number of devices in the registry after the scan.

install.description: A task (meta.kind install) that installs a built device target on its profile's device, with the module's install command spawned in the caller's environment, its output on the task. The target is addressed as Launch/1.prepare_run addresses it (API.md §9.1): the profile is resolved before the task is accepted (a refusal is the refused result); a target that does not resolve or is not a device target, a profile with no device, or a module that cannot install it ends the task nonzero before anything runs. It holds the target's build-directory lock (fail-fast), then the device lock (waiting for a live holder, its holder announced once on the task; a hung holder fails), for the command only. A cancel kills the command.

launch.description: A task (meta.kind launch) that launches a device target on its profile's device, addressed and refused as install is, under the device lock only; then, when the module names the program's bundle, the program's process id is probed. A launch that succeeded is remembered for stop until its owner disconnects. A cancel kills the command or probe.

pid.description: The launched program's process id on the device, when it was found.

bundle.description: The launched program's bundle, when the module names one.

stop.description: Stop the program a finished launch task of the caller launched, with the module's stop command in the caller's environment under the device lock; ok once it succeeded (the launch is then forgotten; also when the module has no stop command). Another client's launch is forbidden; a task that launched nothing (unknown, still running, failed, or already stopped) or a failed stop is the refused result.

changed.description: The registry's records changed (a scan, a device appearing or going away, a profile choosing a device); carries no state and has no initial: a client reads list after subscribing and again on each changed.

seq.description: Increases with each changed this daemon session sends.

Device.description: A device of the registry (API.md §1.1): key its serial, label its name (the serial when it has none).

state.description: online or offline; clients show an unknown state as neutral.

profiles.description: The keys of the profiles that chose it; absent when none did.

TargetParams.description: A device target, addressed as Launch/1.prepare_run addresses a launch target (API.md §9.1).

profile.description: The profile, resolved as Launch/1.build resolves it without interactive (absent: refused, as a non-interactive command refuses it; the editor names its active profile); its device is the one used.

target.description: The target or launch configuration name (absent: the profile's default target).

project.description: The project the target belongs to.

kind.description: Which kind of name target is; absent: either.
